external_primary_evidence.finding: flock locks are advisory and associated with open file descriptions; duplicated/fork-inherited descriptors share the same lock, which is released only after all corresponding descriptors close.

2026 WAL-reset corruption bug affects historical SQLite versions through 3.51.2 under specific concurrent writer/checkpoint/reset conditions; fixed releases include 3.51.3 and selected backports. Target VPS Python SQLite 3.45.1 is therefore conservatively treated as vulnerable by current discriminator.
HTTP 409 Conflict plus typed application/problem+json is a suitable transport surface for FRANK_BUSY state conflict; 429 is not preferred because BUSY is not rate limiting.

Snapshot restore can move observed revision backward; revision bump and compaction mechanisms are used to invalidate stale client state. This supports testing a monotonic Frank recovery generation independent of a reverted snapshot.

exactly_one_go_oob_experiment.name: CAPABILITY_TIME_CAPSULE
exactly_one_go_oob_experiment.experiment: An already-COMMITTING effect attempt created under execution/presence epoch B is treated as a serialized time-capsule and presented again after successor C owns epoch B+1. Final provider-commit fencing must reject the stale capability even though lifecycle state remains COMMITTING; recovery remains RECONCILE_REQUIRED; no provider effect executes.
exactly_one_go_oob_experiment.scientific_role: Falsifies the hypothesis that durable lifecycle state or serialized provenance can recreate live execution capability authority.
